body:
### What are you really trying to do?

Running a Temporal workflow that executes a Local Activity.

### Describe the bug

After upgrading RoadRunner from `2025.1.12` to `2025.1.13`, any workflow that executes a Local Activity crashes the worker with a nil pointer dereference panic during workflow task processing.

Worker log output:
```json
{
    "level": "ERROR",
    "ts": "2026-05-05T10:06:01+0000",
    "logger": "temporal    ",
    "msg": "Workflow task processing panic.",
    "Namespace": "default",
    "TaskQueue": "default",
    "WorkerID": "roadrunner:default:db50f62b-293f-4e09-a791-9762ccd241e8",
    "WorkflowID": "d2a30722-202d-42aa-97e2-7a5bf5e0124e",
    "RunID": "048befd9-d1c4-455c-ac47-1f4fdf95820e",
    "WorkerType": "LocalActivityWorkflow",
    "Attempt": 1,
    "PanicError": "runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference",
    "PanicStack": "(see below)"
}
```

Panic stack:
```
workflow task for default [panic]:
go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*workflowExecutionEventHandlerImpl).ProcessLocalActivityResult(0xa7e9658c1f8, 0xa7e96a0e0c0)
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_event_handlers.go:1795 +0x214
go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*workflowExecutionContextImpl).ProcessLocalActivityResult(0xa7e965ae280, 0xa7e969e3a10, 0x3c700e0?)
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_task_handlers.go:1282 +0x6f
go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*workflowTaskHandlerImpl).ProcessWorkflowTask(0xa7e95534100, 0xa7e969e3a10, 0xa7e965ae280, 0xa7e965b43c0)
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_task_handlers.go:1015 +0x82b
go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*workflowTaskProcessor).processWorkflowTask(0xa7e95a4a000, 0xa7e969e3a10)
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_task_pollers.go:504 +0x66f
go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*workflowTaskProcessor).ProcessTask(0xa7e95a4a000, {0x2098220, 0xa7e969e3a10})
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_task_pollers.go:440 +0x26e
go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*baseWorker).processTaskAsync.func1()
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_worker_base.go:550 +0x12f
created by go.temporal.io/sdk/internal.(*baseWorker).processTaskAsync in goroutine 154
	go.temporal.io/sdk@v1.42.0/internal/internal_worker_base.go:529 +0x8c
```

### Minimal Reproduction

This can be reproduced with the PHPUnit tests included in the PHP SDK.

1. Enable logging in `tests/Functional/.rr.silent.yaml`
2. Run the "Functional" test suite, specifically `SimpleWorkflowTestCase.testLocalActivity`.

The test will timeout and the log file at tests/Functional/test-feature.log will contain an error.

### Environment/Versions

- OS and processor: Alpine Linux (AMD64) in Docker
- SDK Version: master (>= v2.17.1)
